requirements.title: A CODIMENSION statement has an optional double colon and a declaration list
requirements.definition: The CODIMENSION keyword is followed by an optional double colon and a nonempty codimension-decl list. Every item has the R838 form, including its bracketed coarray-spec. R401 owns list expansion. This is an other-specification-stmt under R513; it is neither an allocation/synchronization action nor the CODIMENSION attr-spec in a type/component declaration.

pending.with-double-colon: PENDING compile-only positive-control admission: a complete module with IMPLICIT NONE, INTEGER :: a, CODIMENSION :: a[*], and END MODULE. The statement is the only CODIMENSION specification; a is an ordinary nonallocatable scalar with implicit module SAVE, constant explicit coshape and rank0/corank1. Qualify a Fortran2023 coarray-declaration profile without launching images or requiring a coarray runtime link. No value, bound or communication observation.
pending.without-double-colon: PENDING compile-only positive-control admission in the same complete module context, spelling CODIMENSION a[*]. Both colons are omitted together, not replaced by a single colon. Keep the ordinary type, scalar rank, explicit coshape, sole attribute specification and C826 SAVE premise unchanged. Admission of this syntax is not evidence of allocation, remote accessibility, image count or synchronization.
pending.mixed-complete-note: PENDING compile-only positive-control admission completing the original informative example in one module: IMPLICIT NONE; INTEGER :: a, b; INTEGER, ALLOCATABLE :: c; then CODIMENSION a[*], b[3,*], c[:]. a and b are saved nonallocatable scalar coarrays; c is an allocatable scalar coarray with deferred coshape. Ordinary rank is0 for all three; coranks are1,2,1. The declared upper cobound3 does not require three executing images. No initialization, allocation, payload or unavailable-cobound inquiry. The note supplies an example, not a separate obligation or execution claim.
pending.required-list: PENDING one-predicate diagnostic/positive-control pair in the complete module with INTEGER :: a: submit CODIMENSION :: alone; repair only by appending a[*]. The repaired entity has module SAVE, a permitted type and valid explicit coshape, so no missing-lifetime or unsupported-type error is hidden. Require a missing statement-list cause under the selected reporting capability, not a disabled-coarray or link error. No fatal rejection or printed R837 is required.
pending.single-colon: PENDING one-predicate diagnostic/positive-control pair: CODIMENSION : a[*] in the eligible scalar module, repaired only by inserting the second colon. Coarray-spec syntax, module SAVE and type/rank/corank remain valid. Diagnose the statement separator rather than C827/C828 or a generic coarray facility failure. The repair is a compile admission, not a successful multi-image run.
pending.list-wrapper-graph: PENDING finite graph R837 -> R401 nonempty comma list -> R838 per-item name/bracket/specification, for singleton explicit, singleton deferred and the completed three-item original example. Bind each actual item span and declaration identity; do not let only the first item carry a coarray-spec for the entire list. Grammar-list predicates and C815 duplicate attributes retain their owners. A future reviewed numbered-wrapper/source relationship is needed; current supplementary-target links and existing component-attribute programs confer no automatic credit, and identical programs must not be cloned.

requirements.oracle: Complete coarray declaration units with otherwise legal types, shape/coshape and storage roles; compile-only admissions and source-minimal required-list/separator report-control pairs. Source-wrapper plans require actual source-item/identity evidence in addition to canonical source eligibility.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Unsupported or disabled coarrays, missing runtime libraries, crashes, generic wrong-context errors and resource limits are not causal syntax evidence. Required standard reporting is not mandatory fatal rejection, a fixed diagnostic string or a printed rule code. The declaration does not allocate an allocatable entity, establish payload definition or observe any inter-image event. All facets and relationship mechanisms remain pending.

requirements.title: Each CODIMENSION declaration names an object and supplies literal brackets
requirements.definition: A codimension-decl is a coarray-name followed by lbracket, coarray-spec and rbracket. R779/R780 define the literal square brackets; they are not BNF optionality marks. R402 supplies the name syntax and R809 supplies the coshape alternatives. There is no parenthesized ordinary array-spec slot in this production. The statement gives the named object CODIMENSION; a prior explicit CODIMENSION specification is not a prerequisite.

pending.explicit-scalar: PENDING compile-only positive-control admission in a complete module with IMPLICIT NONE and INTEGER :: a, followed by CODIMENSION :: a[*]. Nonallocatable a has module SAVE, ordinary rank0 and corank1; its only coshape specification is in this statement. R811/C828 own the explicit coshape. No prior coarray declaration, run, data initialization or inquiry is needed for grammar admission.
pending.explicit-array: PENDING compile-only positive-control admission in a complete module with INTEGER :: a(2), then CODIMENSION :: a[3,*]. Ordinary rank1/extent2 comes from the type declaration; corank2 comes from the coarray-spec, so rank+corank=3. Module SAVE and constant explicit coshape satisfy C826/C828. No array shape is written inside the CODIMENSION statement, no image-count threshold is inferred, and no bounds or payload read is proposed.
pending.deferred-scalar: PENDING compile-only positive-control admission in a complete module with INTEGER, ALLOCATABLE :: a, then CODIMENSION :: a[:]. Scalar ordinary rank0 and corank1 remain distinct. C827/R810 own deferred coshape and9.7.1.3 owns allocation status; the declaration performs no allocation and supplies no observable allocation cobounds or defined payload. No explicit CODIMENSION elsewhere or initialized allocatable variable.
pending.deferred-array: PENDING compile-only positive-control admission in a complete module with INTEGER, ALLOCATABLE :: a(:), then CODIMENSION :: a[:,:]. The first colon list belongs to ordinary deferred shape under C834; the second supplies corank2 under C827. Rank1/corank2 is below C822's sum limit. Allocation state, data bounds, cobounds and type parameters are not interchangeable, and no inquiry on unallocated data or absent dummy is proposed.
pending.mandatory-specification-group: PENDING one-predicate diagnostic/positive-control pair: a complete module declares INTEGER :: a but has CODIMENSION :: a without the bracketed group; insert only [*] for the control. Module SAVE and the ordinary scalar type remain fixed. The cause is R838's mandatory group, not a supposed requirement to have declared a coarray earlier. Empty brackets instead of an omitted group would require the separate R809 specification analysis and are not an extra local case here.
pending.opening-bracket: PENDING one-predicate diagnostic/positive-control pair in the eligible nonallocatable scalar module: CODIMENSION :: a*], repaired by inserting [ immediately after a. The remaining tokens, declaration and storage role stay fixed. Require a missing opening-delimiter cause at this declaration site, with the R779 literal definition recorded as a canonical dependency. Do not reinterpret malformed syntax as a successful scalar declaration or count an unsupported-coarray report.
pending.closing-bracket: PENDING one-predicate diagnostic/positive-control pair in the same eligible module: CODIMENSION :: a[* followed by the statement terminator; insert only ] for the control. No continuation token or unrelated following statement is changed. Qualify a missing closing-delimiter cause with R780 retained as owner of its spelling; parser recovery, a crash, resource exhaustion or merely an error somewhere in the unit is not corroboration.
pending.name-not-array-designator: PENDING one-predicate diagnostic/positive-control pair: in a complete module declare INTEGER :: a(2), then use CODIMENSION :: a(1)[*]; repair only by deleting (1). The control declares the whole array as a coarray while keeping its rank/extent and implicit SAVE unchanged. The statement has a coarray-name slot, not an array-element designator or an ordinary array-spec slot. R402 owns name syntax; C826/C828 and shape/type conditions are valid independently.
pending.coarray-spec-owner: PENDING finite source graph for the explicit [*]/[3,*] and deferred [:]/[:,:] contexts through R809 to R810/R811-R813 and C822-C829. Each item must retain ordinary rank/corank, ALLOCATABLE/nonallocatable role and the proper C826 storage/association premise. Empty interiors, a missing final star, allocatable explicit coshape and nonallocatable deferred coshape keep their canonical grammar/constraint owners, not fabricated local R838 diagnostics. Declaration acceptance supplies neither allocated cobounds nor dynamic state. No reused component or type-declaration occurrence is silently relabelled as this statement.
pending.entity-and-scope-graph: PENDING finite declaration/identity relationship for exactly three complete source contexts: the module scalar above; an ordinary scalar coarray dummy declared in a contained module subroutine with an explicit interface and no calls; and a separately typed INTEGER, SAVE scalar in a BLOCK within a complete program, with CODIMENSION local to the BLOCK. Record actual name/statement spans, rank/corank and C826's SAVE/dummy alternative. CODIMENSION names are local under19.5.1.4p2 and BLOCK specifications declare construct entities under19.4p3/11.1.4; they are not arbitrary modifications of a host or USE-associated entity. A later dummy call must meet15.5.2.7/.9 and actual lifetime/contiguity/VOLATILE conditions. No local S runtime classifier or source-use instance is created.

requirements.oracle: Inspect and admit the four bounded ordinary-rank/coshape declaration contexts, and compare four source-minimal missing-group/delimiter/name-slot negatives to conforming repairs. Fix type, role, ordinary shape and storage eligibility before interpreting a diagnostic. Canonical grammar, state and scope relationships need explicit independently reviewed source/interface evidence.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The lbracket/rbracket tokens are literal syntax, not optional coarray annotation. R809/C827/C828/C826/C834, component eligibility, USE/HOST/BLOCK identity and actual/dummy rules are not waived by this wrapper. No undefined value, unallocated cobound, expired target, allocation/synchronization effect or compiler-layout oracle is inferred. Zero-sized/zero-length definedness under19.6.2 does not establish allocation, association or presence. Standard-required reporting need not be fatal or print R838; all facets remain pending.

accounting.rationale: Original whole statement production: keyword, optional double colon, nonempty declaration list. R401/R838 retain nested ownership.
The original uses the syntactic terms lbracket and rbracket, not optional brackets. Every name needs its own coarray-spec; R779/R780 and R809 remain the defining owners.

Normative statement-to-attribute definition, not a new allocation, communication or no-op S effect. PENDING finite source/attribute/identity relationship for actual R837/R838 occurrences through8.5.1 and8.5.6, with correct entity, type, shape/coshape and storage roles.

The statement specifies CODIMENSION; it does not require a prior explicit CODIMENSION declaration. PENDING source confirmation of the sole attribute-specification site and the coarray interpretation under8.5.6.1/5.4.7. Another explicit specification can activate C815;8.2p2's within-type-declaration override is not a general cross-statement exception.

The subjects are listed objects, each with its own declaration. PENDING finite module/dummy/BLOCK identity maps under C823-C826/19.4/19.5.1.4. Scalar and array coarrays are both possible; function results, inappropriate intrinsic-module types, components in a wrong declaration context, USE respecification and invalid storage roles do not become conforming through R838 spelling.

The explicit8.5.6 reference retains the general, deferred-coshape and explicit-coshape catalogues as canonical owners. Rank/corank and allocation/association/cobound effects stay there and in9.7/15.5/19. Existing component-attribute and legacy coarray cases keep their IDs, roles and inputs; no automatic numbered-wrapper link or SourceUses instance.

The complete original example is one mixed CODIMENSION list. It is not a standalone program or a normative extra obligation. Complete types and C826/C827/C828 contexts are prerequisites to any later use.

PENDING bounded completion as one module with INTEGER a,b, INTEGER ALLOCATABLE c, and the original list; no duplicate CODIMENSION specifications. R837 mixed-complete-note names its prospective compile admission, not a separate note-owned program.
a[*] can be completed as a saved nonallocatable scalar coarray. Corank1 is not ordinary rank1; module SAVE supplies C826 without asserting any payload or allocation observation.

b[3,*] has two codimensions. Complete it as a saved nonallocatable scalar with constant explicit coshape. The upper cobound3 is not a rank, storage-size or mandatory executing-image-count oracle;5.4.7 allows an incomplete final rectangular image pattern.

C828 excludes deferred coshape for a nonallocatable coarray. Give c ALLOCATABLE so C827/R810 apply, without initialization or allocation. Deferred coshape supplies corank, not allocated cobounds, ordinary shape, type parameters, defined payload or presence. No unallocated inquiry is used as evidence.
